# `aube ignored-builds`

- **Usage:** `aube ignored-builds [-g --global]`
- **Effect:** read-only

Print packages whose install scripts were skipped by the `allowBuilds` allowlist

<!-- docs-navigation:start -->

## Examples

```sh
aube ignored-builds
```

Read the [workflow guide](/package-manager/lifecycle-scripts) for context.
[Global options](/cli/#global-flags) apply to this command too.

<!-- docs-navigation:end -->

## Flags

- **`-g --global`** — Operate on globally-installed packages instead of the current project.
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
